DIAGNQSJICS AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE (U240E)
0/D Main Switch & 0/D OFF Indicator Light Circuit
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
The 0/0 main switch is a momentary type switch. When pressing the 0/D main switch, the 0/0 OFF indicator
light lights up and ECM prohibits shifting to 0/D, and when pressing it again, the 0/D OFF indicator light goes
off and ECM allows shifting to 0/D. Turning the IG switch OFF will reset the 0/0 OFF Indicator light.
